concept.title: Account and Licensing
concept.shortdesc: Every StreamForge product that touches the cloud shares one account and licensing system.

section.title: Creating your StreamForge account
section.p: A StreamForge account is a single sign-on identity that works across StreamForge Cloud, StreamForge Mobile, and StreamForge Studio Pro. Create one at the StreamForge account portal using an email address and password, or sign in with an existing Google or Apple identity.

section.title: Plans and tiers
section.p: StreamForge products ship in two tiers: Free, which covers core recording, capture, and upload functionality, and Pro, which unlocks multi-camera switching, advanced overlays, team collaboration, and higher cloud storage and transcoding limits. Tier is tied to the account, not the installed application, so signing in unlocks the same tier everywhere.

section.title: Activating a Pro license
section.p: A Pro license activates automatically the first time you sign in to a Pro-capable product with an account that has an active Pro subscription. No separate license key entry is required.
